facts.what: Q2FY27 results (first quarter with QCIL consolidated): Screener shows revenue Rs2,829 cr, operating profit Rs655 cr (23%), interest Rs119 cr, depreciation Rs150 cr, minorities Rs60 cr, attributable PAT Rs262 cr, EPS Rs3.01; deck and transcript filed Nov-2026. Our GAM estimates for QCIL's interest and minorities look low against this quarter.

Sep-2026 half-year balance sheet: equity capital Rs872 cr, reserves Rs6,919 cr (net worth Rs7,791 cr excl. minorities), minorities Rs1,439 cr, borrowings Rs5,940 cr incl. leases Rs1,981 cr, cash Rs2,156 cr; intangibles Rs3,704 cr.
Sep-2026 shareholding (filed Oct-2026): promoters 53.78%, FIIs 12.26%, DIIs 21.66%, public 12.17%.
Motilal Oswal cut its target to Rs870 after Q2FY27 (9-Nov-2026); PL published a Q2FY27 note on 9-Nov-2026; Trendlyne consensus Rs865-879 (18-Nov-2026).
